comments_text: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (92.31%) to Aurein 1.2 I: 23%, F=A=K: 15%. Activity: Active against S. aureus ATCC 25923 (MIC 16 ug/ml), E. faecalis PCM 2673 (MIC 32 ug/ml), E. coli ATCC 25922 (MIC 8 ug/ml), P. aeruginosa ATCC 9027 (MIC 64 ug/ml), C. albicans ATCC 10231 (MIC 64 ug/ml). In vitro toxicity: human RBC: HC50 128-256 ug/ml, less hemo.lytic. half-life in vitro:serum:bovine (25%): ~6 h (44% left after 6 h). Structure: random coil in PBS and helical in SDS or DPC micelles.
title: Alanine Scanning Studies of the Antimicrobial Peptide Aurein 1.2.
